title: NBA 2K27
description: Nothing is out of reach for Victor Wembanyama, including becoming the face of the league. The reigning Defensive Player of the Year is shattering records at an unprecedented pace, and his talent can only be described as otherworldly. The future has arrived and it’s on the cover of NBA 2K27. Caitlin Clark is changing the game with her limitless range, but it’s her will to win that’s fueled her rapid ascent from college phenom to WNBA superstar. Clark holds the all-time NCAA Division I scoring record for both men and women, is a No. 1 overall pick, Rookie of the Year, two-time All-Star, and the ultimate competitor. Take the court with NBA 2K27 Deluxe Edition and make every possession a viral highlight. He started with a dream on the South Side of Chicago, and built a legacy that inspired the world. Derrick Rose is the youngest MVP in NBA history, a three-time All-Star, an icon on and off the court, and an NBA 2K cover star. Celebrate his career with NBA 2K27 Ultra Edition and follow in his footsteps as you lead an NBA franchise.[2K Sports]

critic_reviews.quote: NBA 2K27 turns out to be a very polished installment that knows how to listen to its fans. The debut of the NBA 2K HQ app is an excellent tool for managing your MyPLAYER and your team without needing to turn on the console, despite how tricky its face scan can be. On the other hand, the integration of AI and a more refined narrative make its story mode an exciting journey, perfect to enjoy even in co-op.

NBA 2K27 does a great job of expanding the court-level experience, adding more realistic player interactions rather than standardized, simplified animations. A more consolidated City experience gives you the social aspect of street hoop without all the excessive running around. Finally letting men and women play together in The City is a long-awaited addition. Broadcasting and off-court presentation take up a lot of unskippable time, and the MyTeam experience lacks the same amount of immersion and story for female players as male players get. All in all, NBA 2K27 is a good entry in the long-running franchise, especially if you haven't played in a while.

NBA 2K27 delivers great on-court basketball in an excellent visual package but still has some work to do off the court. The on-court experience took a real leap… but the off-court modes need to match that energy.

NBA 2K27 takes meaningful steps toward improving the on-court experience, especially on defense, with more dynamic animations and a new cooperative experience. However, it still carries many of the franchise’s long-standing issues, including invasive microtransactions and pay-to-advance mechanics. Eras mode remains the crown jewel and is enough on its own to justify buying the game. For basketball and sports fans, it is the most complete simulator on the market, making it an easy purchase to recommend. For newcomers, it remains an accessible game, although watching a few videos beforehand certainly wouldn’t hurt.

It has plenty of good ideas, but doesn’t go far enough to really make them shine as they should. Of course, it doesn’t help that long-running issues and ever-present microtransactions continue to weigh things down. You couldn’t honestly call 2K27 a money-grab because of how many new twists the developers have added, but it feels like 2K has done just enough to bring players back, hoping they’ll continue to spend money on the flagship modes and not notice Dennis Rodman standing in the corner, jacking up airballs from deep.

NBA 2K27 stands out for its enormous level of visual detail and a highly fluid interface. This installment innovates by integrating the WNBA into The City to allow the first mixed matches in the franchise, in addition to debuting the new Crew HQ. The gameplay achieves an excellent balance: it adds new offensive tools and presents a much more solid and challenging defense, something that shines especially in the MyNBA mode. In short, a very promising experience that I will detail in depth in my upcoming review of the final version. [4-Hour Hands-On Impressions]
If 2K26’s defense was a benchwarmer, 2k27's is the Most Improved Player. [Review in Progress]
